h1: Playgrounds in India: How We Can Ensure All Children Have Access to Play

props.title: Playgrounds in India: How We Can Ensure All Children Have Access to Play
props.summaryText: Access to play is about more than the number of playgrounds. Distance, safety, inclusion, gender and upkeep all decide whether a child can actually play, and each can be improved.
props.author: meera-iyer
props.imageAlt: Children on swings at a playground

takeaways.text: Access depends on distance, safety, inclusion, cost and upkeep, not only on the number of playgrounds.
Small play spaces close to homes reach more children than distant large parks.
Inclusive design and safe routes open playgrounds to girls and children with disabilities.
Maintenance keeps playgrounds open; without it, access disappears.

faq.q: What stops children in India from accessing playgrounds?
faq.a: Distance from home, unsafe routes or spaces, poor lighting, equipment that excludes children with disabilities, social restrictions on girls' movement, fees in private spaces, and broken or closed equipment.

faq.q: How can playgrounds be made more accessible?
faq.a: Create smaller play spaces close to homes, make routes and spaces safe and well lit, design inclusively, keep public playgrounds free, and fund regular maintenance.
